objects.description: long black rubber conveyor belt on the right carrying crushed grey ore, with a big rock jammed between the belt and a roller
red mushroom emergency-stop button next to the conveyor
large grey electrical box on a steel pillar at the left with a big red rotary handle and a yellow 'PUNTO DE BLOQUEO' sign below it
red safety padlock with a red-and-white 'PELIGRO' tag
the large dark rock stuck between the conveyor belt and its roller

actions.visual_cue: the worker presses the red emergency-stop button and the moving belt comes to a stop
the worker turns the big red rotary handle on the grey box at the left from vertical (ON) to horizontal (OFF)

the red padlock is IN CONTACT WITH THE RED ROTARY HANDLE in the newest frame: its shackle is being hooked through the handle and snapped shut, or the padlock and its red-and-white tag already hang from the handle. A padlock that is only held in the hand, carried, raised toward the box or put in a pocket, without touching the handle, is NOT this action: answer null
with the padlock on the handle, the worker presses the start button and the belt does not move
the worker stands at the conveyor on the right, bent over the belt, reaching into it with gloved hands or gripping the jammed rock between the belt and the roller
